title.narrative: Acceleration of digital transformation in Turkmenistan

description.narrative: Turkmenistan stands at a critical juncture in its digital transformation, with the Government demonstrating a clear strategic commitment to economic diversification and digital innovation through its key policy frameworks. However, unlocking the full potential of digital technologies requires overcoming persistent structural challenges. These include gaps in digital infrastructure, an evolving policy environment, limited investments in systemic reforms, and the need for stronger institutional capacity to integrate advanced technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digital platforms. Addressing these constraints is essential to accelerating inclusive growth, enhancing global competitiveness, and positioning Turkmenistan as a regional leader in the digital economy. Gender-specific challenges and leveraging opportunities for women and marginalized groups is critical to ensuring an inclusive and equitable digital transformation.
